title: Type 1 Diabetes, Endothelin, and Skeletal Muscle Mitochondrial Dysfunction: The Role of Sirtuin-1
official: Type 1 Diabetes, Endothelin, and Skeletal Muscle Mitochondrial Dysfunction: The Role of Sirtuin-1
summary: The proposed study is designed to test the hypothesis that treatment of resveratrol for 12 weeks will improve both endothelin-B receptor (aim 1) and skeletal muscle mitochondrial function (aim 2) in people with type 1 diabetes.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Men and premenopausal women
* All races
* Clinical diagnosis of insulin-dependent type 1 diabetes (patients only)

Exclusion Criteria:

* Clinical diagnosis of hepatic, cardiovascular, or renal disease
* Uncontrolled diabetes (HbA1C \>12%)
* Diabetic complications (i.e. neuropathy)
* Uncontrolled hypertension (\>140/90 mm Hg on therapy)
* Pregnancy
* Use of vasoactive medications
